question: Lenovo Group Limited parent company
markdown:
Lenovo is a publicly traded company, with its largest shareholder being Legend Holdings, which owns 31-36%. CEO Yang Yuanqing owns about 5.9%, and public investors hold the rest. It is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and has dual headquarters in Beijing and Morrisville, North Carolina.
Lenovo is a publicly traded company owned by public shareholders.
Lenovo's largest single stakeholder is the private holding firm Legend Holdings.
Legend Holdings owns roughly 31% to 36% of Lenovo.
Yang Yuanqing, CEO and Chairman of Lenovo, owns about 5.9% of the shares.
Institutional and private investors own the remaining 60% plus of the company.
Lenovo shares are traded on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under the stock code SEHK: 992.
Lenovo operates as a global enterprise with dual headquarters in Beijing, China, and Morrisville, North Carolina, USA.
Lenovo is a publicly traded Chinese company, not owned by the government.
